summary: Generate plugin SKILLS.md and per-skill SKILL.md files from baseline_catalog.yml with a CI --check gate to prevent drift.
migration_impact: Baseline catalog edits must run `python3 scripts/generate-plugin-skills.py` before merge. Plugin manifests now declare `skills: skills/`. Grok marketplace index will list bundled skills after regenerating plugin-index.json.
agent_notes: Never hand-edit `plugin/SKILLS.md`, `.plugin/SKILLS.md`, or `skills/*/SKILL.md`. Edit `src/plate_core/data/baseline_catalog.yml`, run the generator, commit outputs, and let CI enforce sync.
migration_guidance: 2. Run `python3 scripts/generate-plugin-skills.py` to refresh `plugin/` and `.plugin/` skill surfaces.
3. Run `python3 scripts/generate-grok-plugin-index.py` if marketplace previews should include the new skills.
4. Commit generated files; CI runs `generate-plugin-skills.py --check` on every PR.
